game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the chapel bell.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the chapel bell. Each round, frost imps strike the chapel bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the chapel bell from frost imps in Skating Pond: keep the vault meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: vault drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Skating Pond'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Skating Pond.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while vault > 0.
